title: Meal Planner
summary: Drag recipes into a weekly grid and turn the whole week into one shopping list.

cards.heading: What Meal Planner does
cards.body: Meal Planner is a 7-day grid across breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Assign any recipe to any slot and Iron Rabbit does the shopping math for you.

cards.heading: Adding a recipe to a day
cards.body: Tap an empty slot in the grid. Pick from 15 built-in recipes or tap **Add custom recipe**. The slot fills with the recipe's name and cover.

cards.heading: Turning the week into a shopping list
cards.body: Tap **Generate shopping list** at the bottom. Iron Rabbit collects every recipe's ingredients into one new note, grouped by supermarket department.

cards.heading: Tip: Reuse a favourite week
cards.body: **Tip:** Long-press any day and pick **Copy day** to duplicate it. Great for kids who insist on the same Monday breakfast forever.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Custom recipes with no ingredients skip the shopping list. Always add at least one ingredient — even just "chef's choice" — so nothing gets missed.
